Proof in the paper: The selected area electron diffraction (SAED) expressly exhibits four bright concentric rings, ascribed to the (1 1 1), (2 0 0), (2 2 0), and (3 1 1) crystal planes in sequence, reflecting the polycrystalline characteristics of Pt-rich PtCo NFs (Figure S2). The HAADF-STEM image obviously shows that the radial flower is assembled with ultrathin nanosheets (Figure 1b), which provides enough channels for electron transfer and proton exchange. A high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) image shows defective sites on the nanosheets, which would contribute to superior catalytic performance (Figure 1e).
